title: When the Archive Turns
author: Juniper Vasquez
blurb: Lena Nakamura, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
